text: ORG Technology's 2025 annual report lists Shanghai Xiwang Beverage Co., Ltd. (上海犀旺饮料有限公司) among the other enterprises controlled by ORG's controlling shareholder, Shanghai Yuanlong Investment Holding (Group) Co., Ltd. (上海原龙), which holds 32.84% of ORG; the report names Zhou Yunjie (周云杰) as ORG's ultimate controller.
short: Shanghai Xiwang Beverage is controlled by ORG's controlling shareholder, Shanghai Yuanlong (Zhou Yunjie)

source.name: 奥瑞金科技股份有限公司 (ORG Technology Co., Ltd.): 2025年年度报告 (2025 annual report, on cninfo)
source.quote: 上海犀旺饮料有限公司(以下称“上海犀旺”) 控股股东控制的其他企业
source.note: Notes on related parties (十四、关联方及关联交易), pages 224-225: parent 上海原龙 holds 32.84% of shares and votes; '本企业最终控制方是周云杰'; 上海犀旺 is listed as 'another enterprise controlled by the controlling shareholder'. Shareholder table (page 85) lists 上海原龙投资控股（集团）有限公司 as a 境内非国有法人 (domestic non-state legal person).
